name: Leadforce (Neon CRM) — Enrich (Apollo) → Validate (Clay) → Qualify → Send (SpaceMail) every 30 min

parameters.query: SELECT id, first_name, last_name, email, organization, district_name, state, website FROM leads WHERE enrichment_status IS NULL AND suppressed = false ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 100

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ first_name: $json.first_name, last_name: $json.last_name, email: $json.email, organization_name: $json.organization || $json.district_name, domain: ($json.website || '').replace(/https?:\/\//, '').split('/')[0] || undefined, reveal_personal_emails: false }) }}

parameters.query:
WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE leads SET
    title = $2,
    linkedin_url = $3,
    advisor_name = $4,
    enrichment_status = $5,
    enriched_at = now()
  WHERE id = $1
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO pipeline_logs (stage, lead_id, status, detail)
SELECT 'enrichment', id, 'success', $6::jsonb FROM updated

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('Loop Enrich — 1 at a time').item.json.id }}, ={{ ($json.person || {}).title || null }}, ={{ ($json.person || {}).linkedin_url || null }}, ={{ ($json.person || {}).name || null }}, ={{ $json.person ? 'enriched' : 'not_found' }}, ={{ JSON.stringify({ person_found: !!$json.person }) }}

parameters.query: SELECT id, first_name, last_name, email, organization, district_name FROM leads WHERE enrichment_status = 'enriched' AND validation_status IS NULL AND suppressed = false ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 100

WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE leads SET
    validation_status = $2,
    validator_used = 'clay',
    validated_at = now()
  WHERE id = $1
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO pipeline_logs (stage, lead_id, status, detail)
SELECT 'validation', id, 'success', $3::jsonb FROM updated

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('Loop Validate — 1 at a time').item.json.id }}, ={{ ($json.status === 'valid' || $json.result === 'valid' || $json.deliverable === true) ? 'valid' : 'invalid' }}, ={{ JSON.stringify({ raw_status: $json.status || $json.result || null, deliverable: $json.deliverable || null }) }}

parameters.query:
WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE leads SET
    qualified = TRUE,
    qualified_at = now()
  WHERE validation_status = 'valid'
    AND enrichment_status = 'enriched'
    AND qualified = FALSE
    AND suppressed = FALSE
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO pipeline_logs (stage, lead_id, status, detail)
SELECT 'qualification', id, 'success', '{"reason":"validated_and_enriched"}'::jsonb FROM updated

SELECT id, email, first_name, last_name, district_name, state, subject_line, email_body, sequence_day, send_attempt_count, priority_score FROM leads WHERE qualified = true AND send_status IS NULL AND suppressed = false ORDER BY priority_score DESC NULLS LAST, created_at ASC LIMIT 100

parameters.query:
WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE leads SET
    send_status = 'sent',
    email_status = 'sent',
    sender_account = 'benefitcheck@benefitview.us',
    sent_at = now(),
    send_attempt_count = send_attempt_count + 1
  WHERE id = $1
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO pipeline_logs (stage, lead_id, status, detail)
SELECT 'send', id, 'success', '{"sender_account":"benefitcheck@benefitview.us"}'::jsonb FROM updated
